questions.q: From which country did Panama separate in 1903?
questions.why: The United States backed the move.

questions.q: Which country controlled the Canal Zone until 1999?
questions.why: Panama took full control on 31 December 1999.

questions.q: Which Spanish explorer first saw the Pacific from Panama in 1513?
questions.why: He called it the South Sea.

questions.q: Which 1977 treaties agreed to hand the canal to Panama?
questions.why: Omar Torrijos and Jimmy Carter signed them.

questions.q: Which military ruler was removed by a US invasion in 1989?
questions.why: He was taken to the United States for trial.

questions.q: Which pirate sacked Panama City in 1671?
questions.why: The old city was moved after.

questions.q: Which 1964 riots over flying the flag are remembered as Martyrs' Day?
questions.why: They happened on 9 January.

questions.q: Which new, larger set of canal locks opened in 2016?
questions.a: Panama Canal expansion (Agua Clara and Cocolí)
questions.why: It lets much bigger ships pass.

questions.q: Who became Panama's first woman President, in 1999?
questions.why: She was the widow of Arnulfo Arias.

questions.q: What is the capital of Panama?
questions.why: It has a skyline of skyscrapers.

questions.q: Which Caribbean port held huge Spanish treasure fairs?
questions.why: Its forts are a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which archipelago in the Caribbean is home to the Guna people?
questions.why: They govern it themselves.

questions.q: Which old quarter of Panama City is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It was built after the 1671 sack.

questions.q: Which jungle region on the Colombian border has no road?
questions.why: The Pan-American Highway stops there.

questions.q: Which artificial lake forms part of the canal?
questions.why: It was the world's largest artificial lake in 1913.

questions.q: Which island national park is a former prison and a UNESCO site?
questions.why: Its waters are full of marine life.

questions.q: Which island chain near Costa Rica is popular with surfers?
questions.why: It has a Caribbean feel.

questions.q: Which Panamanian boxer is called 'Hands of Stone'?
questions.why: He beat Sugar Ray Leonard in 1980.

questions.q: At which World Cup did Panama make its debut?
questions.why: Panama scored against England.

questions.q: Which Panamanian salsa singer starred in films and ran for President?
questions.why: He was later Minister of Tourism.

questions.q: Which colourful textile panels do Guna women sew?
questions.why: They use layered cloth.

questions.q: Which Frank Gehry museum in Panama City is about biodiversity?
questions.why: It has bright coloured roofs.

questions.q: Which waterway joins the Atlantic and Pacific through Panama?
questions.why: It opened in 1914.

questions.q: What is Panama's official currency alongside the US dollar?
questions.why: It is named after the explorer.

questions.q: Which country first tried to build the canal in the 1880s?
questions.why: Ferdinand de Lesseps led the effort.

questions.q: Which disease killed many French canal workers?
questions.why: Mosquito control later made the US build possible.

questions.q: Which famous hat is wrongly named after Panama?
questions.why: It is made in Ecuador.

questions.q: Which chicken soup is Panama's national dish?
questions.why: It is flavoured with culantro.

questions.q: Which Panamanian baseball player was the first unanimous Hall of Famer?
questions.why: He was a famous Yankees closer.

questions.q: Which coffee variety from Boquete sells for record prices?
questions.why: It came from Ethiopia.
